channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump warns Iran of 'decapitation' after ship hit in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Trump threatened Tehran with 'decapitation' on Monday after a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile, authorities said.

item.title: FDNY reports 12 injured in Astor Place subway fire
item.description: NYC's emergency alert system warns of delays on Brooklyn-bound 4 and 6 trains.

item.title: Suspect in Twin Falls In-N-Out shooting identified after 3 killed, 7 wounded
item.description: Police said the suspect, 24-year-old Chad Williams, died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

item.title: Pirro meets with Trump at White House amid questions about her future
item.description: U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro met with President Trump at the White House Monday afternoon amid questions about her future, sources said.
